title: Quiet Pages Retreat

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min in a reading nook; ventilate after.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; avoid fabrics.

why_it_works: Earthy patchouli grounds the space, while soft mandarin and herbal clary sage add a gentle uplift—ideal for cozy, focused reading.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
